subject: Change in behaviour of Markdown figure captions

messages.author: c584965fac2b99d6
messages.subject: Change in behaviour of Markdown figure captions
parts:
Hi
I just updated a whole load of R packages and my RStudio/markdown->Leanpub workflow has gone to pot. Assuming knitr is still used by RStudio to generate md from Rmd on the way to producing html, I notice that expressions of the form:

```{r myimg, fig.cap="My caption"}
plot_some_image()
```

that used to render:

![My caption](myimg.png)

now get rendered *in the markdown* as:

<div class="figure">
<img src="myimg.png" alt="My caption"  />
<p class="caption">My caption</p>
</div>

which is not what I want at all.

How do I the original, simpler md formatting back?

thanks
tony
